mechanism: Perphenazine (dopamine antagonist) directly opposes pramipexole's (dopamine agonist) therapeutic effects while increasing risk of extrapyramidal side effects and neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only if antipsychotic therapy is essential; monitor closely for loss of pramipexole efficacy, extrapyramidal symptoms, and signs of neuroleptic malignant syndrome including fever, rigidity, and altered mental status.
